in_hindi.long_meaning: One who gives pleasure to the mind.

in_tamil.name: மனிராம்

in_telugu.name: మనిరామ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is our Meesha (Lord) of the mind and Ashobhayojeshvar (destroyer of sorrow)

in_marathi.name: Maniram
